references.text: Noah became drunk from wine and lay uncovered, a parallel to the use of wine leading to shameful acts.
Tamar seduces her father-in-law Judah to secure an heir, another example of questionable actions taken to ensure descendants.
The law forbids sexual relations with close relatives, showing that Lot's daughters' actions were contrary to God's will.
Wine is a mocker and strong drink causes unruliness – it warns against the deceit of wine, relevant to Lot's daughters' use of wine.
Woe to him who makes his neighbor drunk in order to see his nakedness – directly relevant to the act of making Lot drunk.
